def run(_context):
    op_name = "Rough_Adaptive2D"

    # Pocket: z=50 (top/stock top) down to z=30 (floor) = 20mm deep
    # WCS origin is at top center => z=0 in WCS = z=50mm in model
    # Pocket floor is at z=30mm model = -20mm WCS => bottomHeight_offset = -20mm from stock top
    # But bottomHeight_mode='from contour' means from the selected contour face (z=50 top)
    # We leave mode='from contour' and set offset=0 so it cuts to the pocket floor automatically
    # Top height: stock top (z=0 WCS)

    result = mb.set_params(op_name, {
        # Cutting load & step
        "optimalLoad":           {"value": 5.0,   "unit": "mm"},   # 40% of 12.7mm
        "maximumStepdown":       {"value": 5.0,   "unit": "mm"},   # 5mm = ~40% D
        # Feeds & speeds
        "tool_feedCutting":      {"value": 1200,  "unit": "mm"},   # mm/min
        "tool_feedRamp":         {"value": 400,   "unit": "mm"},   # mm/min
        "tool_spindleSpeed":     {"value": 5000,  "unit": "raw"},  # RPM
        # Stock to leave for finishing
        "stockToLeave":          {"value": 0.5,   "unit": "mm"},   # radial + axial stock
        # Heights
        "topHeight_mode":        {"value": "from stock top",  "unit": "choice"},
        "topHeight_offset":      {"value": 0,     "unit": "mm"},
        "bottomHeight_mode":     {"value": "from contour",    "unit": "choice"},
        "bottomHeight_offset":   {"value": 0,     "unit": "mm"},
        # Ramp
        "rampType":              {"value": "helix", "unit": "choice"},
        "helicalRampDiameter":   {"value": 6.0,   "unit": "mm"},
    })
    print("Params set:", json.dumps(result, indent=2))
